name: Compliance and Safety
description: Starter pack for compliance and safety officers: walkthroughs, training renewals, permits, drills and audit evidence.

definitions.title: Daily safety walkthrough
definitions.note: Walk the work areas, check guards, signage, housekeeping and PPE use.
steps: Log every finding with a photo note

definitions.title: Weekly housekeeping check
definitions.note: Check aisles, exits and storage areas are clear.

definitions.title: Weekly safety meeting
definitions.note: Hold the toolbox talk and record attendance and topic.

definitions.title: Monthly fire extinguisher check
definitions.note: Check gauges, seals, pins and accessibility on every extinguisher.
steps: Check the gauge is in the green zone
Check the safety pin and tamper seal
Confirm clear access and signed tag

definitions.title: Monthly first-aid kit check
definitions.note: Restock the first-aid kits and check expiry dates.

definitions.title: Quarterly evacuation drill
definitions.note: Run the evacuation drill and record times and findings.
steps: Run the drill and time the evacuation

definitions.title: Quarterly PPE inspection
definitions.note: Inspect all personal protective equipment and replace worn items.

definitions.title: WHMIS and safety training refresher
definitions.note: Run the annual refresher and file attendance records.

definitions.title: Fire permit renewal
definitions.note: Renew the fire permit and file the certificate.

definitions.title: Environmental permit renewal
definitions.note: Renew environmental permits and submit required reports.

definitions.title: Annual safety audit
definitions.note: Complete the full internal safety audit and write the action plan.

definitions.title: Incident report follow-up
definitions.note: Document an incident and track corrective actions - set the due date when creating it.
